'''Nar Chan''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Dreamdancer]] who lived at the [[Poloda Place]] apartment complex on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Shadows" /> by [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' to [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. The novel establishes that Nar Chan was at [[Poloda Place]] over twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before, equating to by [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].</ref> While there, Chan held unruly bacchanal events inside its court, each of which lasted for a [[Standard week/Legends|week's]] [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Shadows" /> By [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> these events were still viewed as infamous, and many considered Chan to be very immoral and decadent.<ref name="Shadows" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Den Dhur]] thought about Chan and her bacchanals while he was in Poloda Place, remembering the [[Artist/Legends|artistic]] individuals who had lived there due to its perceived safety, spacious living areas, and low rent.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nar Chan was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]] as the second installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' trilogy.<ref name="Shadows" />
